title: Implement canonical switch queries in linear tape transitions
body:
A fixed **3,237-location, fourteen-tape program** computes the exact canonical padded-rotation switch in at most **1024(h+4) literal transitions**, including validation, preparation, output, clearing and every head return. It preserves the five borrowed descriptors, returns one owned Boolean, retires eight private bodies/guards and adds at most 16(h+4) historical cells. This lowers the published quadratic service bound in [PR #7593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7593) to linear work on the same ABI. **No new kappa** or complete CRT caller improvement is claimed.

Read the [proof and cost table](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa/research/linear-tape-rotation-switch/PROOF.md), [fixed graph emitter](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa/research/linear-tape-rotation-switch/program.py), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa/research/linear-tape-rotation-switch/RESULT.json), [separate sparse interpreter](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa/research/linear-tape-rotation-switch/independent.py), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa/research/linear-tape-rotation-switch/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa/research/linear-tape-rotation-switch/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa/research/linear-tape-rotation-switch/CREDITS.md).

The graph lowers [PR #7734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7734)'s closed descent. Canonical shrinking counters make zero detection constant and countdowns linear in total. A two-carry scan consumes the low d bits once, then writes both high quotients once. It uses no host-integer instruction, variable-distance move, array lookup, callback or child recursion. Exact input-bit sensitivity makes the standalone linear order sharp; this is not a lower bound for queries with precomputed advice.

```text
T <= 548(h+1)+719 <= 1024(h+4)
K_after <= K_entry+16(h+4)
```

| Evidence | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Two instruction interpreters | All 1,566 entries in 49 complete networks through height 3 |
| Historical current-wire row | All 544 queries at h=5, s=17, j=6 |
| Wider owned returns | 42 queries through height 4096 |
| Complete return state | Every input, private cell, guard, output, head, visited span and transition count |
| Controls | 13 invalid domains per interpreter, 3 wrong-semantic graphs, 1 failed-retirement graph, 2 alias rejections |

On the same 544 supplied fixtures, a fresh replay of the retained graph uses **1,473,152 transitions**; the new graph uses **1,341,888**, with a maximum of 2,545 per query. Both counts include service setup and cleanup. Host fixture serialization, actual offsets, transport, payload use and output retirement are excluded from both. These exact service counts are not wall-clock timings, an uninterrupted caller, or a comparison with ROM reuse.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/linear-tape-rotation-switch
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_LINEAR_TAPE_ROTATION_SWITCH 14 tapes; 1024*(h+4) transitions
```

Normal and optimized replay, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44392846255/job/135114797039) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. The all-height claim follows from the written carry/counter/ownership invariants and source-loop counts, not fixture timing.

Jerry Chen supplied the [ABI and prior proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/56335a406469fad85e88ff72820d506d8bea6f63/research/literal-canonical-rotation-switch/PROOF.md), builder, primary hardware and cleanup. Those retained modules are called unchanged; new initialization adapts the source. Ali Romman supplied the [closed formula](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57bb6efed1be1dda9eb1a0f622ec2773bc8b0047/research/rotation-switch-closed-descent/PROOF.md). Nick Petalas supplied the endpoint/child formulas in [PR #7504](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7504). Cinna Davis supplied the [canonical compiler](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a/research/unconditional-batched-crt/check_batched_crt.py) in [PR #4100](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4100). Their notices and predecessor credit remain intact.

The ABI supplies serialized inputs, disjoint blank windows and unique left framing. It does not promise recovery from aliasing, guard corruption or unterminated streams. Actual CRT source/offset production, descriptor conversion, current-wire payload updates, transport, output retirement and complete repeated-query pricing remain open. Historical full suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Consumed heads: PR7593 `56335a406469fad85e88ff72820d506d8bea6f63`, PR7734 `57bb6efed1be1dda9eb1a0f622ec2773bc8b0047`, and canonical compiler `337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a`. All eleven retained files have exact byte pins. No unmerged source ancestry is asserted. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. Separate interpretation shares the emitted graph and ABI; no independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed. Apache-2.0. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19717356).
